candidates.change_summary: Remove the onlyAdmin modifier so anyone, not just admins, can create an emergency oracle.
Pass address(0) as the oracle owner so the constructor's transferOwnership always reverts.
Delete the emit statement so no NewEmergencyOracle event is emitted.
Emit the new oracle address as the owner argument and the caller as the newOracle argument, swapping the event fields.
Check isAdmin[tx.origin] instead of isAdmin[msg.sender], so admin status of the originating EOA is used.
Invert the admin check so the call succeeds only when the caller is NOT an admin.
